workflow_runs.display_title: pm-258/t-1623: Add on-demand local gate closure check

head_commit.message:
pm-258/t-1623: Add on-demand local gate closure check

node scripts/check-gate-closure.mjs preflights the locked modules and
embedded Postgres binaries, then runs this checkout's real
lib/e2e-runner.test.ts, lib/end.test.ts and lib/urashima.test.ts as
bounded nested node --test children. It prints one fingerprinted
otohime.gate-closure.v1 JSON result and exits nonzero on any spawn
error, nonzero exit, signal, timeout, missing, skipped or malformed
result, or fingerprint failure. External evidence is always left
inconclusive.

lib/gate-closure.test.ts drives the verdict logic through a fake
child-runner port, the real runner's timeout/process-group kill, the
real CLI, and a temp-copy negative control that removes serial
enforcement from scripts/e2e.mjs.

workflow_runs.display_title: pm-270/t-1605: Anchor the leftover-child check and bound the deploy s…

head_commit.message:
pm-270/t-1605: Anchor the leftover-child check and bound the deploy step at 12 minutes

The contract checks re-run on HEAD 3ae76a4 (Linux, GNU timeout 9.4) found two failures:
- vercel-deploy.test.sh reported 31/33. `pgrep -f "sleep 6011"` matched any
  process whose command line quotes that text (here the agent's own), and
  `pgrep -x sleep` showed no real leftover. It is now anchored to the fake's
  argv, `^sleep 6011$`. Negative control: with bounded() mutated to
  `timeout --foreground`, both child checks fail again.
- The wiring check required timeout-minutes: 12 in production. ec59663
  (pm-249/t-1569) raised the job to 18 for verify-deploy's live e2e. The job
  stays at 18, and "Deploy and verify the served sha" gets its own 12-minute
  step budget, so a stall names the deploy step.

vercel-deploy.sh is unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
